about: The workspace screens that Trillion's web client (trillion-apps web/src/workspace) draws, moved byte for byte into the Workshop tool that owns the feature, each under its source path inside the tool. The ruling (the owner's ruling, 2026-11-03 1:02 AM CST): the engine and the web app keep only generic primitives, and features, screens and tools move one to one into Workshop tools. A group is owner_only: it moves the screen file and the helpers only that screen uses, and every file of the web shell they import stays where it is, imported as written; the client build answers those imports with the shell's files (web/scripts/workshop-shell-imports.mjs, from the tool's moved-from.json), and the page opens the screen as a screen module (web/scripts/screen-modules.mjs) named by its Workshop row.

calls.means: A real person's name in a source comment, by its place (before a date), swapped for a made-up one: a public tree holds made-up data only.
A real person's name in a source comment, by its place (before a date or a quote), swapped for a made-up one: a public tree holds made-up data only.
A direct BLAKE3 import swapped for the declared content-identity owner, which one-owner-per-registered-name makes the only place that names the hash.
The hex helper only the direct BLAKE3 call used; the owner hands the hex back.
The owner's identity is `1f:` and the same 64 hex digits; dropping the three-character prefix gives the exact hex the grant row already holds.
One funnel's mount takes back the control scope the tool host's loading state left on its element, so the cards keep the borders they had when the page mounted the screen itself.

groups.joins_tool: tools/notifications reads and sends a person's notices; this brings the screen where a person chooses which notices reach them and how (tool:screen-notification-settings)
groups.capability: choose which notices reach me and how

groups.joins_tool: tools/settings keeps the settings a person has for each tool as rows of their own list; this brings the Settings screen where a person steps through those settings pages, with the pages it draws itself and the rail's DATA (tool:screen-settings)
groups.capability: open Settings and step through its pages

groups.joins_tool: tools/send-to-a-place sends what a person picked to a place they name; this brings Your tray, where the picked things wait with the note and Send to chooser (tool:screen-tray)
groups.capability: see what I picked and send it with a note

groups.joins_tool: tools/keep-copies-in-step reads whether every copy of a person's things is in step and settles two versions; this brings the page's catch-up sources and the screens that show them: Your devices, its preview, the status line and Two versions (tool:screen-catch-up, tool:screen-catch-up-preview, tool:screen-catch-up-status, tool:screen-two-versions)
groups.capability: see whether my devices are in step and keep one of two versions

groups.joins_tool: tools/decide-when-things-show keeps a person's show rules, presets and who they share one with; this brings the admin screen that shares a preset with people (tool:screen-show-rules-admin)
groups.capability: share a show-rules preset with people

groups.joins_tool: tools/browse-and-upload-my-files sends a person's files and folders into their space; this brings the screen where they browse, search and upload them (tool:screen-files)
groups.capability: browse and upload my files and folders

groups.joins_tool: tools/show-any-file-as-itself shows a file in its own form; this brings the screen that opens one file with its notes, transcript and uses (tool:screen-file) and the helpers only that screen imports
groups.capability: open one of my files and see it as itself

groups.joins_tool: tools/organize-my-files proposes, applies and undoes new titles and folders for a person's files; this brings the screen where they review them (tool:list-file-tidy)
groups.capability: review the titles and folders my AI suggests for my files

groups.joins_tool: tools/show-the-media-library-and-search-what-was answers the Media page; this brings the Media screen (tool:screen-media) and the note-list helpers only it imports
groups.capability: browse my recordings and media and search what was said in them

groups.joins_tool: tools/show-the-media-library-and-search-what-was answers the saved edits of the Media page (GET and POST /media/edit); this brings the screen that plays and reviews the clips chosen from Media (tool:screen-media-edit) with its panels
groups.capability: play and review the clips I chose from Media

groups.joins_tool: tools/show-every-file-i-used-newest-first keeps every file use; this brings the screen that lists them newest first by day (tool:recent-files)
groups.capability: see every file I used, newest first

groups.joins_tool: tools/recently-deleted-and-storage keeps what a person deleted or archived and puts it back; this brings the screen that lists it with the days each has left (tool:recently-deleted) and its storage panel
groups.capability: see what I deleted or archived and put it back

groups.joins_tool: tools/browse-inspiration-clips sorts everything worth making from into named rows of cards; this brings the screen that draws them (tool:inspiration)
groups.capability: see everything worth making from, as rows of cards

groups.joins_tool: tools/record-voice-and-meetings holds the recorder, the live words and the saved-recording code the Record screen is built on (record-in-the-browser, heard-words, send-while-recording); this brings the screen where a person records a voice memo or a video of themselves and sees their words as they speak, with the notice that says which device is listening (tool:screen-record)
groups.capability: record a voice memo or a video of myself and read my words as I say them

groups.joins_tool: tools/record-voice-and-meetings holds the Record audio panel, the recordings library and the meeting start and notes settings; this brings the screen that mounts them with the person's recordings, saved configurations and calendar context, and the calendar event kept for an ad-hoc recording (tool:screen-record-audio)
groups.capability: record my voice and meetings and keep what I recorded

groups.joins_tool: tools/record-video-with-teleprompter holds the recording panel, its capture, silence stop and the recording session decoder; this brings the screen that mounts them with the person's takes, script and starter layouts and the page a recording opens on (tool:screen-record-video)
groups.capability: record a video of myself with a teleprompter and keep my takes

groups.joins_tool: tools/record-cameras-and-microphones-all-day holds the recorder that opens every camera and microphone and cuts each into clock-aligned pieces; this brings the screen where a person turns each input on, sees what is recording and the pieces still to send, with the network cameras and device switches beside them (tool:screen-always-recording)
groups.capability: record every camera and microphone on this device without end

groups.joins_tool: tools/decide-with-a-method keeps a person's decisions as their own records and already reads them for the Decisions screen (tool:see-my-decisions); this brings the screen that lists them and takes the person's answer (tool:screen-decisions)
groups.capability: see the decisions my AI made and answer the ones waiting for me

groups.joins_tool: tools/what-is-waiting-on-me gathers everything that waits on one person into one answer; this brings the screen that walks through those things one at a time (tool:screen-waiting)
groups.capability: go through everything only I can do, one thing at a time

groups.joins_tool: tools/see-what-my-ais-did keeps what every connected AI did so the person sees it on the AI activity screen; this brings the activity screen, the Errors tool's screen (entry activity) and the screen that traces how one thing happened (tool:screen-activity, tool:errors, tool:screen-activity-trace)
groups.capability: see what my AIs did and how each thing happened

groups.joins_tool: tools/see-what-is-being-worked-on shows everything being worked on by every AI and person; this brings the AI work screen that shows who handed what to which AI and what each AI is on now (tool:screen-ai-work)
groups.capability: see who handed what to which AI and what is being worked on

groups.joins_tool: tools/see-what-is-being-worked-on already holds the message task canvas join (message-task-canvas.mjs); this brings the screen that lists every message's tasks (tool:screen-message-task-canvas)
groups.capability: see the tasks my AIs broke each message into

groups.joins_tool: tools/gather-audience-questions holds the audience-question admission and sources; this brings the review desk screen for them (tool:screen-audience-questions)
groups.capability: check real audience questions and keep approved ones for drafts

groups.joins_tool: tools/hand-work-to-ais keeps the jobs a person's AIs hand each other as the person's own records; this brings the view where a person watches one job run, the work, the parts handed on and every step, and tells whoever has it more (tool:screen-job-run)
groups.capability: watch one job my AIs are doing, step by step

groups.joins_tool: tools/messages-screen is the Messages screen's tool (its README: every conversation with AIs and in spaces, drawn with the shared chat part); this brings the screen itself where its conversation list already lives (tool:screen-messages)
groups.capability: read and answer my conversations with AIs and in spaces

groups.joins_tool: tools/calendar keeps a person's calendar; the one Calendar screen (tool:screen-calendar and the grid, settings and tasks rows that share it) draws it, and its mail pane is the Mail screen's EmailSurface imported from email-screen.tsx (tool:screen-mail), so the two screens move together into the larger user's tool
groups.capability: see my calendar and read and write my mail beside it

groups.joins_tool: tools/social-posts keeps the person's posts and holds both rows whose screens these are: tool:read-post-calendar (the posting calendar) and tool:check-a-post (Posts); both screens share new-post.tsx, so they move together
groups.capability: write, check and schedule my posts

groups.joins_tool: tools/build-and-send-a-sales-contract holds the sales contract builder's DATA and its README names the builder screen as the part still in the app; this brings the screen (tool:manage-sales-contracts)
groups.capability: build and send a sales contract

groups.joins_tool: tools/keep-lists-of-rows is the visual-database surface that draws every list in rows, columns and views; this brings the Lists screen (tool:screen-lists, tool:screen-list) that opens a list there, with the row clipboard only that screen uses
groups.capability: keep my lists of rows and open each one

groups.joins_tool: tools/show-my-automations-on-the-signed-in-page-what-sets shows each automation, what sets it off and what it does, and draws a workflow or one run as a board of steps; this brings the Automations screen (tool:screen-workflows, tool:screen-workflow) and the two word makers only it uses
groups.capability: show my automations and open one

groups.joins_tool: tools/funnels-and-offers reads a person's sales funnels from their own records; this brings the screen that draws them stage by stage (tool:screen-funnels, tool:screen-funnel)
groups.capability: see my funnels and each stage

groups.joins_tool: tools/describe-the-workshop describes one tool, who made it and the next call to make; this brings the Runs, Tool and Run screens of the person's page (tool:screen-workshop, tool:screen-workshop-tool, tool:screen-workshop-run)
groups.capability: see my tool runs and describe one tool

groups.joins_tool: tools/tweak-live-controls makes a tool's inputs into rows a person moves; this brings the Controls screen that shows them beside the tool's preview (tool:screen-controls) with the preview file only it uses
groups.capability: adjust a thing with live controls

groups.joins_tool: tools/tours-screen holds the guided tours, the first kind of thing Edit on canvas lays out as all its parts; this brings that screen (tool:screen-canvas-edit) with the kinds DATA only it reads
groups.capability: edit a tour or a screen as parts on a canvas

groups.joins_tool: tools/shape-a-thought-into-my-content-formats shapes a thought into the content formats a person writes and speaks in; this brings the Formats screen (tool:screen-formats) with the recording opener only it uses
groups.capability: shape something I said into a format

groups.joins_tool: tools/read-a-list-view reads one page of what a person's list shows; this brings the two screens that draw any list whose answer describes itself as rows (tool:screen-sent, tool:screen-spend, tool:screen-visitors, tool:screen-price-tests) or as one chart (tool:screen-chart), one home for the files four tools' rows name
groups.capability: read any list or reading as rows or one chart

groups.joins_tool: tools/saved-examples keeps the posts, videos and pages that worked; this brings the screen that draws them (tool:list-saved-examples)
groups.capability: see the examples I saved

groups.joins_tool: tools/show-the-persons-spaces-on-the-signed-in-page-answer reads the person's spaces for the signed-in page (src/work-spaces.mjs names spaces-screen.tsx as its Spaces screens); this brings the screens that draw them, the pursuits list and one pursuit (tool:screen-spaces, tool:screen-space), with the places a pursuit turns on (community-screen.tsx, imported only by the spaces screen) and the two files only they use
groups.capability: see my pursuits and everything one holds

groups.joins_tool: tools/choose-where-shares-from-the-phone-browser is where a share from the phone or browser can go and what was shared before; this is the screen where the person chooses (tool:screen-sharing)
groups.capability: choose where shares from my phone and browser go

groups.joins_tool: tools/browse-and-publish-what-my-ai-can-use is the Marketplace shelf (its marketplace-kinds.json names marketplace-screen.tsx as the screen it feeds); this brings the screen (tool:screen-marketplace)
groups.capability: browse and publish what my AI can use

groups.joins_tool: tools/edit-a-site-visually edits a site's pages and owns the editor model this screen already imports (public-app-editor-model.mjs); this brings the Sites screen (tool:screen-public-apps) with the two panels only it uses
groups.capability: edit my sites and read their visitor activity

groups.joins_tool: tools/keep-goals-and-focus keeps a person's goals and the one needle mover and holds Home's own words (home-words.json); this brings Home itself, the screen where a person sees what waits for them, their numbers, their goals and what their AIs did, one part of Home per row (tool:screen-home and its parts, tool:screen-menu-bar)
groups.capability: see where things stand and keep my goals

groups.joins_tool: tools/tours-screen holds the guided-tour engine, the host and the tours' data; this brings the Tours screen that lists every tour and the Waiting tours list (tool:screen-tours, tool:screen-waiting-tours)
groups.capability: list the guided tours I have and have not taken
